 Medium
 Large
 Print A friend or partner says something new, and the old understanding no longer fits. Uranus in Gemini, in your 11th house of friends, networks and long-term gains, forms a trine with Pluto in Aquarius, your 7th house of partnerships and open dealings. Air signs support each other, so change arrives quickly and without much noise. Mercury is retrograde, so wording needs a second read. So hear the new view in full, then take a day before you answer. Leo Career Predictions
 A contact, teammate or business partner may shift a role, a date or a split of duties by message or call. Ask what changed and why. Open the earlier email and compare it with the new version. A group task may restart under new terms. Festival breaks may slow approvals, so ask for the new date in writing. Put each confirmed change in an email. Leo Love Predictions
 A friend may start to mean more, or a partner may share a wish you did not expect. Stay quiet until they finish, then ask one clear question. Couples can grow closer if surprise meets curiosity. Singles may meet someone through a group or a friend’s message. Pride can wait. Let a few talks pass before any label. Leo Money Predictions
 A shared cost, a referral or a group plan may change at short notice. Ask for exact figures and dates. Uranus favours sudden offers, so verify the sender and the amount before you pay. Festival gifts may tempt you, so write one limit on a card and keep it in your wallet. Hold new credit and large buys until Mercury moves direct. Leo Health Predictions
 Nerves run quick, and the calves, ankles and sleep may react to a busy social day. Eat plain meals at set hours, keep festive sweets modest and sip water. Pause between messages to rest your wrists. Keep one evening quiet. And put the phone away an hour before bed. Leo Remedies
 Wait until the next morning before you agree to any change a friend or partner suggests. Raise your feet for ten minutes tonight.
